names: Alexandria Center for Science and Technology – 1450 Owens
summary: 1450 Owens Street is a 7-story, ~215,000 sq ft laboratory/office building (133,000 sq ft lab, ~50,000 sq ft office, 2,600 sq ft ground-floor retail) at the Alexandria Center for Science and Technology's Mission Bay Megacampus, developed by Alexandria Real Estate Equities. The building came online in 2024, with Gladstone Institutes signing a 105,000+ sq ft anchor lease that year.

milestones.text: Building permit issued for the 7-story lab/office building; construction estimated at ~$70 million.
Construction topped out on the seven-story structure (reported by San Francisco YIMBY in February 2023; exact topping-out date not stated).
Building came online; anchor tenant Gladstone Institutes signed a 105,000+ sq ft lease for its data science and genomic immunology institutes.
